title: 복잡한 질문 전략 — 1가지만 선택, 카페 표현
summary: 질문이 여러 가지를 물어봐도 딱 1가지만 골라서 집중 — 다 대답하려다 3배 어려워지고 메시지가 흐려짐
첫 30초 메인포인트가 전체 답변의 질을 결정. MP가 나쁘면 나머지도 나쁠 가능성이 매우 높음
필러를 문장 사이에 끼워 자연스럽게: 'These days, the coffee shops are not just for coffee.' → 'Well, these days, you know, the coffee shops are not just for coffee.'
'and for me, ...' — people에서 나의 감정으로 자연스럽게 전환하는 핵심 표현
'I go to coffee shops to meet my friends' (go to + 동사원형), 'or sometimes go by myself to study English'
결론: 'Yeah, that's pretty much all I have to say.' / 'I think that's why we go to coffee shops these days.' — people 대신 we 사용

keyExpressions.en: The reason why people go to coffee shops has changed quite a bit.
keyExpressions.ko: 사람들이 카페에 가는 이유가 꽤 많이 바뀌었어요.
keyExpressions.note: 'the reason why... has changed' + 'quite a bit' — 둘 다 다양한 주제에 쓸 수 있는 범용 표현

keyExpressions.en: Well, these days, you know, the coffee shops are not just for coffee.
keyExpressions.ko: 있잖아요, 요즘은, 카페가 그냥 커피 마시는 곳만은 아니잖아요.
keyExpressions.note: Well + these days + you know 필러 삽입으로 훨씬 자연스러운 오프너

keyExpressions.en: The coffee shops are not just for coffee.
And for me, I go to coffee shops to meet my friends.
keyExpressions.ko: 그리고 저 같은 경우엔, 친구들을 만나러 카페에 가요.
keyExpressions.note: 'and for me'로 people → 나의 개인 감정으로 자연스럽게 전환

keyExpressions.en: Or sometimes go by myself to study English.
keyExpressions.ko: 아니면 혼자 영어 공부하러 가기도 해요.

keyExpressions.en: I think that's why we go to coffee shops these days.
keyExpressions.ko: 그게 요즘 우리가 카페에 가는 이유인 것 같아요.

keyExpressions.en: Yeah, that's pretty much all I have to say.
keyExpressions.ko: 네, 그게 제가 할 말의 전부예요.

keyExpressions.en: They go for the same reasons I do.
keyExpressions.note: 다른 사람들과 나를 연결할 때. 'like me'보다 훨씬 명확
'grab some coffee'는 대화체로는 자연스럽지만 OPIC 설명 중엔 어색. 그냥 'go get coffee'나 'go to a coffee shop'으로

cards.front: 질문이 여러 가지를 물어볼 때 전략
cards.back: Just pick one thing and focus on that. The question doesn't matter — your one clear message does.
cards.example: Even if the question asks about multiple reasons, just pick one and go deep.

cards.front: 카페에 가는 이유가 변했다고 말하기 (범용 표현)
cards.back: The reason why people go to coffee shops has changed quite a bit.
cards.example: The reason why people go to coffee shops has changed quite a bit over the years.

cards.back: Well, these days, you know, the coffee shops are not just for coffee.
cards.example: Well, these days, you know, the coffee shops are not just for coffee. The reason why has changed quite a bit.

cards.back: And for me, I go to coffee shops to meet my friends.
cards.example: People go for all kinds of reasons. And for me, I go to coffee shops to meet my friends.

cards.back: Or sometimes go by myself to study English.
cards.example: And for me, I go to coffee shops to meet my friends, or sometimes go by myself to study English.

cards.front: 카페 결론 문장 — why, we 사용
cards.back: I think that's why we go to coffee shops these days.
cards.example: It's not just about the coffee anymore. I think that's why we go to coffee shops these days.

cards.back: Yeah, that's pretty much all I have to say.
cards.example: I love how the atmosphere feels like a library. Yeah, that's pretty much all I have to say.

cards.front: 사람들도 나처럼 같은 이유로 카페에 간다고 표현
cards.back: They go for the same reasons I do.
cards.example: I go to study, and honestly, they go for the same reasons I do.

cards.back: If you talk about 3 things, you've made your answer 3 times harder. One topic = clearer message, higher score.
cards.example: Don't list 3 reasons. Pick one and go deep — it's easier for you and clearer for the grader.

cards.back: There is a very high chance that the rest of your answer will also be of poor quality if your first 30 seconds is not so good.
cards.example: Always nail your main point in the first 30 seconds.
